statusVocabulary.REGENERATED: the producer ran on the candidate and its output is retained
statusVocabulary.BYTES-MATCH: two or more independent regenerations, and the committed artifact where one exists, are byte-identical
statusVocabulary.VERDICTS-AGREE: two or more regenerations agree on every verdict and count; bytes not compared
statusVocabulary.PASS-ONLY: only a job or test conclusion exists
statusVocabulary.VALIDATED: the source is the artifact; its validator ran on the candidate and passed
statusVocabulary.RE-MATERIALIZED-VERIFIED: pinned input fetched again and verified against its pins; never rebuilt
statusVocabulary.PRODUCER-FAILS-BY-DESIGN: the producer exits non-zero for a registered reason the inventory records; counts are as registered
statusVocabulary.FAILED: the producer's own verdict is a failure that is not registered as expected; needs a maintainer decision
statusVocabulary.NOT-REGENERATED-BY-RULE: the inventory or contract forbids or excludes regeneration

gates.cause: One invocation was cut by the harness's own job deadline: win-x64 job 1, attempt 15, verification-full ('the job deadline cut an invocation'). That runner (windows-2025, image 20260925.250.1, 4 CPUs, same as job 2) ran verification-full in a median 233.0 s against 149.5 s for win-x64 job 2 and 136.6-145.6 s on win-arm64 (determinism/attempt-timing.json), so its invocations alone took 4,117 s (about 69 minutes) and the 75-minute job left no room for the last one. The cut invocation filled every case it had not observed with Timeout; under the registered rule, values from an invalid attempt are compared, so each such case reads DISAGREE (this is the protocol's recorded 'harnessCutInconsistency'). All 470 DISAGREE cases are that one attempt's Timeout fill against identical observed values (Passed, or 0|Completed) in all 149 completed attempts on all five platforms. The 1,174 INCOMPLETE cases are the 1,170 cells, the 3 generated artifacts, and invocation:oracle-isolated: the cut verification-full invocation had already recorded all 1,170 cells and the 3 artifact hashes, all equal to every other attempt's, but values from an invalid attempt never count toward agreement, and the cut attempt never ran oracle-isolated. No two observed values differ anywhere. This bounds nothing under the protocol: only DETERMINISTIC establishes anything.
gates.consequence: G3 is not closed on the candidate, and the protocol has no execution slot left (maxExecutions 3). Not re-run (retryPolicy; no slot). Decision for the maintainer.
